task.title: Add a note to a person
task.shortdesc: Write down something you know about a person that does not fit in a date or a place.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Choose under the part for a note, then choose at the bottom.

info.p: Scroll the sheet to find the part.

stepresult.p: A form opens with one box for the note.

step.cmd: Choose in the list on the left, then .

stepresult.p: The note shows under , with and a button to delete it. writes another one. adds a note that is already in the tree.

result.p: The note belongs to that person. Write what you know. Say where you read it if you can.

You can use one note for more than one person. Open the second person, choose , then , then . Search for the note and choose it. Each note shows how many records use it. The note then says that it is shared with another record.
